email.subject: CoastAir's site is losing calls
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I looked at CoastAir's site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: it's not mobile-friendly, so most searchers on their phones struggle to even read it, and there's no click-to-call button, so the ones who do get there can't tap to ring you — they have to copy the number manually, and most won't bother.

Also worth fixing: no reviews shown, a footer with an old year still on it, and a page title that doesn't say "HVAC" or "Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in search.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no pitch.

Alex
Northlight Web
